title: Cancel daemon startup readiness waits before forced stop escalation
goal: Interrupt owned leaf-service startup readiness waits and idle supervision sleeps on shutdown before the ten-second readiness deadline while preserving foreign listeners, earlier owned children for teardown, and supervision/stop escalation deadlines (landed in 48232ac201a0bf1968e1f75e93e0718c1b91377d; crates/susi-daemon/src/supervisor.rs later split within Core into crates/susi-daemon-runtime/src/supervisor.rs in 2b0f2e1b05fedd878a5615a495a83afdb510653f while crates/susi-daemon/src/server.rs remained in susi-daemon).
notes: Landed in 48232ac201a0bf1968e1f75e93e0718c1b91377d across crates/susi-daemon/src/supervisor.rs and crates/susi-daemon/src/server.rs. Intra-Core crate split 2b0f2e1b05fedd878a5615a495a83afdb510653f moved crates/susi-daemon/src/supervisor.rs to crates/susi-daemon-runtime/src/supervisor.rs (re-exported by susi-daemon), while crates/susi-daemon/src/server.rs remained in susi-daemon. Acceptance criteria: stalled owned leaf readiness wait is interrupted by shutdown before the 10s deadline with child terminated and no surviving service record; foreign listeners are never signalled or adopted; earlier owned children remain recorded for common teardown; daemon wakes from idle supervision wait without altering supervision cadence or stop escalation deadlines.

reuse.justification: Extended the existing leaf-service readiness wait and daemon supervision shutdown flag in supervisor.rs (now in susi-daemon-runtime after 2b0f2e1b05fedd878a5615a495a83afdb510653f) and server.rs rather than introducing a separate cancellation channel or dependency.
